title: Points in Sight
notes: Free points are impossible to miss: the Stats tab opens with a glowing 'Talent Points' and 'Stat Points' counter at the top. Tap Talent Points to jump straight to your talents.
The Stats button in the menu bar shows the number of free points.
'Talent Tree' is now simply 'Talents', with the number of points right next to it.
A-Rank boss (The Storm Lord) slightly softer.
